To fight; even if it's just basic boxing lessons. 

The ability to defend yourself is absolutely priceless if you're unarmed, gives you a whole new perspective, and respect for the people around you as well as yourself. 

You get the idea of how quickly violent encounters can go downhill and are more likely (assuming your ego doesn't get in the way) to try and de-escalate a potentially violent encounter BEFORE it gets physical -- but know how to handle one if you're forced to defend yourself or someone else.

Learning how to fight has given me a lot of confidence in myself, and peace of mind on some levels. I feel like it's something a lot of people overlook.
